//מחזיר צבע לפי השוואה לערך הקודם
SET vColor_CompareToBelow =

    IsNull(Below($1)) or $1 >= Below($1),
    '$(vColor_SuccessChart)', // ירוק
    '$(vColor_DangerChart)'  // אדום
);

SET vColor_CompareYear =
If(
    GetSelectedCount(Year) <> 1,
    '$(vColor_Gray300)', // אפור

    If(
        [$1] > [$2],
        '$(vColor_SuccessChart)', // ירוק
        '$(vColor_DangerChart)'  // אדום
    )
);

// ====================
// FORMAT
// ====================
// מחזיר מספר מקוצר 
//1B
SET vFmt_RoundedNumber=
If(If($1<0,-$1,$1)>=1e9,
    Num($1/1e9,'#,##0')&'B',
    If(If($1<0,-$1,$1)>=1e6,
        Num($1/1e6,'#,##0')&'M',
        If(If($1<0,-$1,$1)>=1e3,
            Num($1/1e3,'#,##0')&'K',
            Num($1,'#,##0')
        )
    )
);


// מחזיר מספר מקוצר עם 2 ספרות אחרי הנקודה
// דוגמא:
// -1.31B
// 245.22M

SET vFmt_RoundedNumber2D =
Chr(8206) &
If($1 < 0, '-', '') &

If(fabs($1) >= 1e9,
    Num(fabs($1)/1e9,'#,##0.00') & 'B',
If(fabs($1) >= 1e6,
    Num(fabs($1)/1e6,'#,##0.00') & 'M',
If(fabs($1) >= 1e3,
    Num(fabs($1)/1e3,'#,##0.00') & 'K',
    Num(fabs($1),'#,##0')
))) &
Chr(8206);

// מחזיר מספר מקוצר 1 ספרות אחרי הנקודה 
//1.3B
SET vFmt_RoundedNumber1D = If(If($1<0,-$1,$1) >= 1e9,
    Num($1/1e9,'#,##0.0') & 'B',
    If(If($1<0,-$1,$1) >= 1e6,
        Num($1/1e6,'#,##0.0') & 'M',
        If(If($1<0,-$1,$1) >= 1e3,
            Num($1/1e3,'#,##0.0') & 'K',
            Num($1,'#,##0')
        )
    )
);

// מחזיר מספר מלא 
//1,000,000
SET vFmt_LongNumber=
Num($1,'#,##0');

// מחזיר אחוז שלם
// דוגמא:
// -25%
// 18%

SET vFmt_Percentage =
Chr(8206) &
If($1 < 0, '-', '') &
Num(fabs($1), '##0%') &
Chr(8206);

///$tab ICONS
// =====================================================================
// מודל מרכזי: ספריית אייקונים מאוחדת - שכבת מקור
// =====================================================================
// שדות: IconName, IconSource (heroicons/material), IconSet (outline/solid),
//        IconDataURI (data-URI מלא לשימוש כתמונה ב-UI).
//
// *** קריטי 1 - preceding load ***
//   ה-data-URI מכיל פסיק (base64,) שהוא מפריד שדות ב-INLINE. לכן ב-INLINE
//   נשמר Base64 טהור (IconB64) וה-preceding load מוסיף את הקידומת.
//
// *** קריטי 2 - width/height קבועים (24) ***
//   בלי מידה מפורשת, Original size בקליק מגדיל את האייקון עם הקונטיינר.
//   width/height=24 נותנים גודל קבוע. ה-viewBox המקורי נשמר.
//   הסרת width/height נעשית עם negative-lookbehind (?<!-) כדי לא לפגוע
//   ב-stroke-width של heroicons outline.
//
// תוכן: heroicons outline+solid + material outlined. heroicons=MIT, material=Apache 2.0.
// צבע: שחור (#000000).
//
// שימוש ב-UI (Representation=Image, Sizing=Original):
//   =$(vUI_Icon(heroicons,outline,academic-cap))
// =====================================================================

// הצבע הוא שחור F00000 - MDAwMDAw
// אם רוצים צבע אחר יש לקווד את הצבע ל-BASE64 
// ולחהליף (למשל לאדום) MDAwMDAw > RkYwMDAw

///$tab *************** עזרים ***************

///$tab היפוך אנגלית ועברית

// ========= היפוך עברית - Priority =========
// SQL Server | CHAR  - פונקציה: system.dbo.tabula_hebconvert(CUS.CUSTDES) AS CUSTDES
// SQL Server | RCHAR - משתנה:   SET vHebConv = 'CASE WHEN $1 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE system.dbo.tabula_hebconvert($1) END';  ->  $(vHebConv(CUS.CUSTDES)) AS CUSTDES
// Oracle     | CHAR  - פונקציה: system.tabula_hebconvert(CUS.CUSTDES) AS CUSTDES
// Oracle     | RCHAR - פונקציה: REVERSE(CUS.CUSTDES) AS CUSTDES
// ==========================================


///$tab Calendar_WorkDays
/******************************************************************
 Calendar_WorkDays
 בונה טבלת ימי עבודה וזמינות שעות לכל חודש, מתחילת המודל ועד היום.

 - טבלת Holidays: רשימת ימי שבתון (חגי ישראל 2026-2027) לצורך החרגה.
 - ה-LOAD התחתון מייצר שורה לכל יום בטווח (מ-vFromDatePriority עד סוף החודש הנוכחי).
 - ה-LOAD האמצעי מקבץ לפי חודש וסופר רק ראשון-חמישי שאינם חג
   (Mod(date,7): 0=שבת ... 6=שישי, לא תלוי בהגדרות אזוריות).
 - ה-LOAD העליון מוסיף שנה/חודש לתצוגה ומחשב זמינות = ימי עבודה × 9 שעות.

 המפתח WorkDaysKey (MonthStart) מקשר לפקטה דרך MonthStart(שם שדה לקישור במודל הנוכחי).
******************************************************************/

Holidays:
LOAD Date(Date#(HolidayDate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) AS HolidayDate
INLINE [
HolidayDate
02/04/2026
08/04/2026
22/04/2026
22/05/2026
12/09/2026
13/09/2026
21/09/2026
26/09/2026
03/10/2026
22/04/2027
28/04/2027
12/05/2027
11/06/2027
02/10/2027
03/10/2027
11/10/2027
16/10/2027
23/10/2027
];

Calendar_WorkDays:
LOAD
    WorkDaysKey,
    Year(WorkDaysKey)   AS WorkYear,
    Month(WorkDaysKey)  AS WorkMonth,
    WorkDays_IL,
    WorkDays_IL * 9  AS Available_Hours
;
LOAD
    MonthStart(TheDate)  AS WorkDaysKey,
    Sum(
        If(
            Match(Mod(TheDate, 7), 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
            AND NOT Exists(HolidayDate, TheDate),
            1, 0
        )
    ) AS WorkDays_IL
GROUP BY MonthStart(TheDate);
LOAD
    MonthStart( MakeDate(1988) + $(vFromDatePriority)/1440 ) + IterNo() - 1  AS TheDate
AUTOGENERATE 1
WHILE MonthStart( MakeDate(1988) + $(vFromDatePriority)/1440 ) + IterNo() - 1 <= MonthEnd(Today());

DROP TABLE Holidays;
///$tab MasterCalendar
MinMaxDate:
LOAD
    Floor(Max(OpportunityCreatedDate)) AS maxCreatedDate,
    Floor(Min(OpportunityCreatedDate)) AS minCreatedDate
RESIDENT Fact_Opportunity;

LET varMinDate = Num(Peek('minCreatedDate', 0, 'MinMaxDate'));
LET varMaxDate = Num(Peek('maxCreatedDate', 0, 'MinMaxDate'));
LET vAsOfDate  = $(varMaxDate);   

// לוח זמנים לכל הימים בין המינימום למקסימום
TempCalendar:
LOAD
    $(varMinDate) + IterNo() - 1 AS TempDate
AUTOGENERATE 1
WHILE $(varMinDate) + IterNo() - 1 <= $(varMaxDate);

MasterCalendarOpen:
LOAD
    // מפתח מקשר
    Floor(TempDate)                     	        AS OpportunityCreatedDate, //PK

    // שדות זמן נפוצים
    Date(TempDate) 									AS CreatedDate,
    Year(TempDate)                                  AS CreatedYear,
    Month(TempDate)                                 AS CreatedMonth,
    Num(Month(TempDate))                            AS CreatedMonthNum,
    'Q' & (Floor((Month(TempDate)-1)/3) + 1)        AS CreatedQuarter,
    Week(TempDate)                                  AS CreatedWeek,
    Week(TempDate) & '-' & Year(TempDate)           AS CreatedWeekYear,
    Day(TempDate)                                   AS CreatedDay,
    WeekDay(TempDate)                               AS CreatedWeekDay,
    Date(MonthStart(TempDate), 'MMM-YYYY')          AS CreatedMonthYear,
     Year(TempDate) & '-Q' & Ceil(Month(TempDate)/3) AS CreatedQuarterYear,

    // YTD / MTD – יחסית ליום האחרון בדאטה (vAsOfDate)
    If(InYearToDate(TempDate, $(vAsOfDate), 0),  'YTD') AS CreatedYearToDate,
    If(InMonthToDate(TempDate, $(vAsOfDate), 0), 'MTD') AS CreatedMonthToDate,

    // תקופה נבחרת
    If(TempDate = Floor(Today()), 'היום',
    If(TempDate >= Floor(Today())-7, 'שבוע אחרון',
    If(TempDate >= Floor(Today())-30, 'חודש אחרון',
    If(TempDate >= Floor(Today())-90, 'רבעון אחרון',
    If(TempDate >= Floor(Today())-365, 'שנה אחרונה',
                                    'ישן יותר'))))) AS CreatedSelectedPeriodDate

RESIDENT TempCalendar
ORDER BY TempDate ASC;

DROP TABLE TempCalendar;
DROP TABLE MinMaxDate;

///$tab MasterCalendar + Bridge table
/******************************************************************
1) Min/Max dates
******************************************************************/
MinMaxDate:
LOAD
    Floor(Max(OpportunityCloseDate)) AS maxClosedDate,
    Floor(Min(OpportunityCloseDate)) AS minClosedDate
RESIDENT Fact_Opportunity;

LET varMinDate = Num(Peek('minClosedDate', 0, 'MinMaxDate'));
LET varMaxDate = Num(Peek('maxClosedDate', 0, 'MinMaxDate'));


/******************************************************************
2) Calendar range
******************************************************************/
TempCalendar:
LOAD
    $(varMinDate) + IterNo() - 1 AS TempDate
AUTOGENERATE 1
WHILE $(varMinDate) + IterNo() - 1 <= $(varMaxDate);


/******************************************************************
3) Master Calendar Close
******************************************************************/
MasterCalendarClose:
LOAD
    // PK
    Floor(TempDate)                               AS OpportunityCloseDate,

    // Date fields
    Date(TempDate)                                AS CloseDate,
    Year(TempDate)                                AS CloseYear,
    Month(TempDate)                               AS CloseMonth,
    Num(Month(TempDate))                          AS CloseMonthNum,
    'Q' & (Floor((Month(TempDate)-1)/3) + 1)      AS CloseQuarter,
    Week(TempDate)                                AS CloseWeek,
    Week(TempDate) & '-' & Year(TempDate)         AS CloseWeekYear,
    Day(TempDate)                                 AS CloseDay,
    WeekDay(TempDate)                             AS CloseWeekDay,
    Date(MonthStart(TempDate), 'MMM-YYYY')        AS CloseMonthYear,
    Year(TempDate) & '-Q' & Ceil(Month(TempDate)/3) AS CloseQuarterYear,
    If(Floor(TempDate) < Floor(Today()),1,0)      AS IsCloseDatePast
RESIDENT TempCalendar
ORDER BY TempDate ASC;


/******************************************************************
4) Date Periods (Bridge table)
******************************************************************/
Date_Periods:
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    'היום' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) = Floor(Today());

CONCATENATE (Date_Periods)
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    'שבוע אחרון' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) >= Floor(Today())-6
AND Floor(TempDate) <= Floor(Today());

CONCATENATE (Date_Periods)
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    'שבועיים אחרונים' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) >= Floor(Today())-13
AND Floor(TempDate) <= Floor(Today());

CONCATENATE (Date_Periods)
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    '30 יום אחרונים' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) >= Floor(Today())-29
AND Floor(TempDate) <= Floor(Today());

CONCATENATE (Date_Periods)
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    '90 יום אחרונים' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) >= Floor(Today())-89
AND Floor(TempDate) <= Floor(Today());

CONCATENATE (Date_Periods)
LOAD DISTINCT
    Floor(TempDate) AS OpportunityCloseDate,
    '365 יום אחרונים' AS ClosePeriod
RESIDENT TempCalendar
WHERE Floor(TempDate) >= Floor(Today())-364
AND Floor(TempDate) <= Floor(Today());


/******************************************************************
5) Sort order
******************************************************************/
ClosePeriodSortMap:
MAPPING LOAD * INLINE [
ClosePeriod, ClosePeriodSort
היום, 1
שבוע אחרון, 2
שבועיים אחרונים, 3
30 יום אחרונים, 4
90 יום אחרונים, 5
365 יום אחרונים, 6
];

LEFT JOIN (Date_Periods)
LOAD
    ClosePeriod,
    ApplyMap('ClosePeriodSortMap', ClosePeriod, 999) AS ClosePeriodSort
RESIDENT Date_Periods;


/******************************************************************
6) Cleanup
******************************************************************/
DROP TABLE TempCalendar;
DROP TABLE MinMaxDate;

FROM [lib://General:Sharepoint Files/Documents/SECTION ACCESS/SectionAccesPermissions.xlsx](ooxml, embedded labels, table is [360]);

FROM [lib://General:Sharepoint Files/Documents/MAIN/SectionAcces - Admins.xlsx](ooxml, embedded labels, table is Admins);

	VIEW,

RESIDENT ACCESS;

  IF(

SQL SELECT
    ORDI.ORD,

    ORD.CUST,

    CRCY.EXCHANGE,

    ORD.PERCENT          AS DISCOUNT

FROM  TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERITEMS"   ORDI

JOIN  TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERS"       ORD    ON ORD.ORD  = ORDI.ORD
JOIN  TABULA."$(vDB)$AGENTS"       AGT    ON AGT.AGENT = ORD.AGENT
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$CURREGITEMS"   CRCY	  ON CRCY.CURDATE = ORD.CURDATE
                                         	 AND CRCY.CURRENCY = '-2'

//סקשן 3 - FINAL TABLES
/******************************************************************
 UNION by TableList + Tmp_LibDb (vCon1,vCon2,vCon3)
******************************************************************/

Tmp_LibDb:
LOAD DISTINCT LibDb
INLINE [
LibDb
$(vCon1)
$(vCon2)
$(vCon3)
];


FOR t = 0 TO NoOfRows('TableList')-1

    LET vBaseTable = Peek('BaseTable', $(t), 'TableList');
    LET vIsFirst   = 1;

    FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1

        LET vLibDb    = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');
        LET vSrcTable = '$(vBaseTable)_$(vLibDb)';

        IF $(vIsFirst)=1 THEN

            [$(vBaseTable)]:
            NoConcatenate
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vSrcTable)];

            LET vIsFirst = 0;

        ELSE

            CONCATENATE([$(vBaseTable)])
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vSrcTable)];

        ENDIF

    NEXT i

    // ניקוי: DROP לכל טבלאות הביניים של אותה BaseTable
    FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1
        LET vLibDb = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');
        DROP TABLE [$(vBaseTable)_$(vLibDb)];
    NEXT i

NEXT t

//סקשן 4 - STOR & DROP TABLE
/******************************************************************
1) STORE FULL TABLE  (skip $Syn + tmp + control tables)
******************************************************************/
FOR i = 0 TO NoOfTables()-1

    LET vTable = TableName($(i));

    IF NOT WildMatch('$(vTable)', '$Syn*', 'Tmp_*', 'TableList', 'DBList', 'Tmp_LibDb') THEN

        STORE [$(vTable)]
        INTO [$(vQvdPathPR)$(vTable).qvd] (qvd);

    ENDIF

NEXT i;

/******************************************************************
2) STORE BY LibDb (folders exist) - based on TableList
   Saves:  $(vQvdPathPR)<LibDb>/<Table>.qvd
******************************************************************/

FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1

    LET vLibDb = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');   // Malam / Omnitec / Team

    FOR t = 0 TO NoOfRows('TableList')-1

        LET vT = Peek('BaseTable', $(t), 'TableList'); // Agents, Part, ...

        // רק טבלאות שיש בהן LibDb
        IF FieldNumber('LibDb','$(vT)') > 0 THEN

            [Tmp_$(vT)]:
            NoConcatenate
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vT)]
            WHERE LibDb = '$(vLibDb)';

            // שמירה רק אם יש שורות
            IF NoOfRows('Tmp_$(vT)') > 0 THEN
                STORE [Tmp_$(vT)]
                INTO [$(vQvdPathPR)$(vLibDb)/$(vT).qvd] (qvd);
            ENDIF

            DROP TABLE [Tmp_$(vT)];

        ENDIF

    NEXT t

NEXT i
DROP TABLE Tmp_LibDb;

/******************************************************************
FINAL CLEANUP - DROP ALL TABLES FROM MODEL
******************************************************************/

FOR i = NoOfTables()-1 TO 0 STEP -1

    LET vTable = TableName($(i));
    DROP TABLE [$(vTable)];

NEXT i;

SQL SELECT
    TRN.T$PART                    AS PART,
    TRN.TRANS,
    TRN.BRANCH,
    TRN.ORDI,
    TRN.DOC,
    TRN.WARHS,
    TRN.PERCENT                   AS TRN_PERCENT,
    TRN.COST,
    TRN.SECONDCOST,
    TRN.PRICE,
    TRN.TQUANT                    AS TQUANT_TMP,
    TRN.CURDATE,
    TRN.TYPE,
    TRN.STORNOFLAG                AS TRANSSTORNOFLAG,
    TRN.COSTQUANT                 AS TRANSCOSTQUANT,
    TRN.IEXCHANGE,
    TRN.ICURRENCY,
    TRN.IV,
    TRN.FLAG,
    TRN.COSTC,
    DOC.DOCNO                     AS DOCINV,
    DOC.CUST,
    DOC.FLAG                      AS DOCFLAG,
    DOC.IVALL,
    DOC.AGENT,
    CRCY.EXCHANGE,
    IVS.CURRENCY,
    ORDI.ORD,
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT,
//  ORD.TEAM_AGENT2,
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT2,

    ITM.IVCOST,
    ITM.QPRICE,
    IVS.IVNUM,
    IVS.FNCTRANS

FROM TABULA."$(vDB)$TRANSORDER" TRN
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERITEMS" ORDI
    ON ORDI.ORDI = TRN.ORDI
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$DOCUMENTS" DOC
    ON DOC.DOC = TRN.DOC
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$CURREGITEMS" CRCY
    ON CRCY.CURDATE = DOC.CURDATE
   AND CRCY.CURRENCY = '-2'
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERS" ORD
    ON ORD.ORD = ORDI.ORD
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$INVOICEITEMS" ITM
    ON ITM.TRANS = TRN.TRANS
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$INVOICES" IVS
    ON IVS.IV = ITM.IV

WHERE
    TRN.TYPE = 'D'
    AND DOC.CURDATE >= $(vFromDatePriority)
    AND DOC.FLAG = 'Y'
    AND DOC.IVALL <> 'N'
;

    '$(vDB)' & Text(ORD)         AS ORD,
    '$(vDB)' & Text(COSTC)       AS COSTC,
    '$(vDB)' & Text(AGENT)       AS AGENT,
//  '$(vDB)' & Text(TEAM_AGENT2) AS AGENT2,

    // --- Source Info ---
    '$(vDB)'                     AS SourceDB,
    '$(vCon1)'                   AS LibDb,

    // --- Fact Info ---
    'trans'                      AS FactType,
    'UnPaid'                     AS Fact,
    TYPE & DOC                   AS TRANSDOC,

    // --- Compatibility Fields ---
    IF(TRN_PERCENT * 1000 > 0,'1','0')                              AS DisStat,
    Date(MakeDate(1988,1,1) + (CURDATE / (60*24)))                  AS DOCDATE,
    (1 - TRN_PERCENT / 100) * TQUANT * IEXCHANGE * PRICE            AS LineTotalIls,
    (1 - TRN_PERCENT / 100) * TQUANT * IEXCHANGE * PRICE / EXCHANGE AS LineTotalDlr,

    // --- Raw / Measures ---
    TRN_PERCENT AS PERCENT,
    COST,
    SECONDCOST,
    PRICE,
    CURDATE,
    TYPE,
    TRANSSTORNOFLAG,
    TRANSCOSTQUANT,
    IEXCHANGE,
    FLAG,
    ICURRENCY,
    DOCINV,
    EXCHANGE,
    DOCFLAG,
    IVALL,
//  TEAM_COMAGENT,
//  TEAM_COMAGENT2,
    TQUANT,
    'https://malamerp.malam.com/priority/openmail.htm?priority:%20priform#%20DOCUMENTS_D:' & DOCINV & ': mlmsys: tabula.ini' AS PriorirtyUrl,

    // שדות שקייים בטבלאות אחרות
    NULL() AS FNCTRANS,
    NULL() AS IVCOST,
    NULL() AS IVNUM,
    NULL() AS CURRENCY
;

LOAD *,
    TQUANT_TMP / 1000 AS TQUANT
;

SQL SELECT
    TRN.T$PART                    AS PART,
    TRN.TRANS,
    TRN.BRANCH,
    TRN.ORDI,
    TRN.DOC,
    TRN.WARHS,
    TRN.PERCENT                   AS TRN_PERCENT,
    TRN.COST,
    DOC.DOCNO                     AS DOCINV,
    TRN.SECONDCOST,
    TRN.PRICE,
    TRN.TQUANT                    AS TQUANT_TMP,
    TRN.CURDATE,
    TRN.TYPE,
    CRCY.EXCHANGE                 AS EXCHANGE,
    DOC.AGENT,
    TRN.STORNOFLAG                AS TRANSSTORNOFLAG,
    TRN.COSTQUANT                 AS TRANSCOSTQUANT,
    TRN.IEXCHANGE,
    TRN.ICURRENCY,
    TRN.IV,
    TRN.FLAG,
    DOC.CUST,
    ORDI.ORD,
    TRN.COSTC,
    DOC.FLAG                      AS DOCFLAG,
    DOC.IVALL
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT
//  ORD.TEAM_AGENT2
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT2

FROM TABULA."$(vDB)$TRANSORDER" TRN
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERITEMS" ORDI
    ON ORDI.ORDI = TRN.ORDI
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$DOCUMENTS" DOC
    ON DOC.DOC = TRN.DOC
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$CURREGITEMS" CRCY
    ON CRCY.CURDATE = DOC.CURDATE
   AND CRCY.CURRENCY = '-2'
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERS" ORD
    ON ORDI.ORD = ORD.ORD

WHERE
    TRN.TYPE = 'D'
    AND DOC.CURDATE >= $(vFromDatePriority)
    AND DOC.FLAG = 'Y'
    AND DOC.IVALL = 'N'
;

/******************************************************************
TRANSORDER_X
******************************************************************/
Concatenate(TRANSORDER_X_$(vCon1))

LOAD
    // --- Keys / Prefixes ---
    '$(vDB)' & PART              AS PART,
    '$(vDB)' & TRANS             AS TRANS,
    '$(vDB)' & BRANCH            AS BRANCH,
    '$(vDB)' & ORDI              AS ORDI,
    '$(vDB)' & CUST              AS CUST,
    '$(vDB)' & COSTC             AS COSTC,
    '$(vDB)' & IV                AS IV,
    '$(vDB)' & WARHS             AS WARHS,
    '$(vDB)' & ORD               AS ORD,
    '$(vDB)' & AGENT             AS AGENT,
//  '$(vDB)' & TEAM_AGENT2       AS AGENT2,
    '$(vDB)' & FNCTRANS          AS FNCTRANS,

    // --- Source Info ---
    '$(vDB)'                     AS SourceDB,
    '$(vCon1)'                   AS LibDb,

    // --- Source Info ---
    'trans'                      AS FactType,
    'transx'                     AS Fact,

    // --- Compatibility Fields ---
    IF(TRN_PERCENT * 1000 > 0,'1','0')                  AS DisStat,
    If(CURRENCY='-1', IVCOST, IVCOST * EXCHANGE)        AS LineTotalIls,
    If(CURRENCY='-1', IVCOST, IVCOST * EXCHANGE) / EXCHANGE AS LineTotalDlr,
    Date(MakeDate(1988,1,1) + (CURDATE / (60*24)))      AS DOCDATE,
    TYPE & DOC                                         AS TRANSDOC,

    // --- Raw / Measures ---
    TRN_PERCENT AS PERCENT,
    COST,
    SECONDCOST,
    PRICE,
    IVCOST,
    QPRICE,
    CURRENCY,
    EXCHANGE,
    DOCINV,
//  TEAM_COMAGENT,
//  TEAM_COMAGENT2,
    CURDATE,
    TYPE,
    TRANSSTORNOFLAG,
    TRANSCOSTQUANT,
    IEXCHANGE,
    ICURRENCY,
    FLAG,
    TQUANT,
    'https://mtservice.malamteam.com/priority/openmail.htm?priority: priform# AINVOICES: ' & DOCINV & ': teamnet: tabula.ini' AS PriorirtyUrl,

    // שדות שקייים בטבלאות אחרות
    NULL() AS DOCFLAG,
    NULL() AS IVALL
;

LOAD *,
    TQUANT_TMP / 1000 AS TQUANT
;

SQL SELECT
    TRN.T$PART                    AS PART,
    TRN.TRANS,
    TRN.BRANCH,
    TRN.ORDI,
    TRN.DOC,
    TRN.WARHS,
    TRN.PERCENT                   AS TRN_PERCENT,
    TRN.COST,
    TRN.SECONDCOST,
    TRN.PRICE,
    TRN.TQUANT                    AS TQUANT_TMP,
    TRN.CURDATE,
    TRN.TYPE,
    TRN.STORNOFLAG                AS TRANSSTORNOFLAG,
    TRN.COSTQUANT                 AS TRANSCOSTQUANT,
    TRN.IEXCHANGE,
    TRN.ICURRENCY,
    TRN.IV,
    TRN.FLAG,
    TRN.COSTC,
    IVS.IVNUM                     AS DOCINV,
    IVS.CUST,
    IVS.AGENT,
    IVS.FNCTRANS,
    IVS.CURRENCY,
    CRCY.EXCHANGE,
    ITM.IVCOST,
    ITM.QPRICE,
    ORDI.ORD
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT
//  ORD.TEAM_AGENT2
//  ORD.TEAM_COMAGENT2

FROM TABULA."$(vDB)$TRANSORDER" TRN
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERITEMS" ORDI
    ON ORDI.ORDI = TRN.ORDI
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$INVOICES" IVS
    ON IVS.IV = TRN.IV
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$INVOICEITEMS" ITM
    ON ITM.TRANS = TRN.TRANS
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$CURREGITEMS" CRCY
    ON CRCY.CURDATE = IVS.IVDATE
   AND CRCY.CURRENCY = '-2'
JOIN TABULA."$(vDB)$ORDERS" ORD
    ON ORD.ORD = ORDI.ORD

WHERE
    TRN.TYPE = 'X' //חשבונית מס
    AND TRN.CURDATE >= $(vFromDatePriority)
;

NEXT vDB;

/******************************************************************
 CLEANUP
******************************************************************/
FOR i = 0 TO NoOfTables()-1
    LET vTableName = TableName($(i));
    DROP FIELD Dummy FROM [$(vTableName)];
NEXT i;

DROP TABLE DBList_$(vCon1);

/******************************************************************
 FINAL FACT – Merge all TRANSORDER fact tables
******************************************************************/
NoConcatenate
Transorder_$(vCon1):
LOAD *
Resident TRANSORDER_Paid_$(vCon1);

Concatenate(Transorder_$(vCon1))
LOAD *
Resident TRANSORDER_UP_$(vCon1);

Concatenate(Transorder_$(vCon1))
LOAD *
Resident TRANSORDER_X_$(vCon1);

/******************************************************************
 Cleanup
******************************************************************/
DROP TABLE TRANSORDER_Paid_$(vCon1);
DROP TABLE TRANSORDER_UP_$(vCon1);
DROP TABLE TRANSORDER_X_$(vCon1);

// סקשן 3- FINAL TABLES
/******************************************************************
 UNION by TableList + Tmp_LibDb (vCon1,vCon2,vCon3)
******************************************************************/

Tmp_LibDb:
LOAD DISTINCT LibDb
INLINE [
LibDb
$(vCon1)
$(vCon2)
$(vCon3)
];

FOR t = 0 TO NoOfRows('TableList')-1

    LET vBaseTable = Peek('BaseTable', $(t), 'TableList');
    LET vIsFirst   = 1;

    FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1

        LET vLibDb    = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');
        LET vSrcTable = '$(vBaseTable)_$(vLibDb)';

        IF $(vIsFirst)=1 THEN

            [$(vBaseTable)]:
            NoConcatenate
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vSrcTable)];

            LET vIsFirst = 0;

        ELSE

            CONCATENATE([$(vBaseTable)])
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vSrcTable)];

        ENDIF

    NEXT i

    // ניקוי: DROP לכל טבלאות הביניים של אותה BaseTable
    FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1
        LET vLibDb = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');
        DROP TABLE [$(vBaseTable)_$(vLibDb)];
    NEXT i

NEXT t

// סקשן 4- STOR & DROP TABLE
/******************************************************************
1) STORE FULL TABLE  (skip $Syn + tmp + control tables)
******************************************************************/
FOR i = 0 TO NoOfTables()-1

    LET vTable = TableName($(i));

    IF NOT WildMatch('$(vTable)', '$Syn*', 'Tmp_*', 'TableList', 'DBList', 'Tmp_LibDb') THEN

        STORE [$(vTable)]
        INTO [$(vQvdPathPR)$(vTable).qvd] (qvd);

    ENDIF

NEXT i;

/******************************************************************
2) STORE BY LibDb (folders exist) - based on TableList
   Saves:  $(vQvdPathPR)<LibDb>/<Table>.qvd
******************************************************************/

FOR i = 0 TO NoOfRows('Tmp_LibDb')-1

    LET vLibDb = Peek('LibDb', $(i), 'Tmp_LibDb');   // Malam / Omnitec / Team

    FOR t = 0 TO NoOfRows('TableList')-1

        LET vT = Peek('BaseTable', $(t), 'TableList'); // Agents, Part, ...

        // רק טבלאות שיש בהן LibDb
        IF FieldNumber('LibDb','$(vT)') > 0 THEN

            [Tmp_$(vT)]:
            NoConcatenate
            LOAD *
            RESIDENT [$(vT)]
            WHERE LibDb = '$(vLibDb)';

            // שמירה רק אם יש שורות
            IF NoOfRows('Tmp_$(vT)') > 0 THEN
                STORE [Tmp_$(vT)]
                INTO [$(vQvdPathPR)$(vLibDb)/$(vT).qvd] (qvd);
            ENDIF

            DROP TABLE [Tmp_$(vT)];

        ENDIF

    NEXT t

NEXT i
DROP TABLE Tmp_LibDb;

/******************************************************************
FINAL CLEANUP - DROP ALL TABLES FROM MODEL
******************************************************************/

FOR i = NoOfTables()-1 TO 0 STEP -1

    LET vTable = TableName($(i));
    DROP TABLE [$(vTable)];

NEXT i;


///$tab תבנית טעינה ממספר בסיסי נתונים
/******************************************************************
תבנית: טעינה ממספר DBs לטבלאות מאוחדות (Skeleton + Concatenate)
- בלי IF(TableNumber)
- בלי לשכפל LOAD
- כל טבלה: Raw (SQL) -> Target (Concatenate+LOAD) -> Drop Raw
******************************************************************/

/***********************
1) הגדרות
************************/

// רשימת מקורות DB
SET vDBList = 'teamnet','etype','tie';

// שם שדה “דמה” לטבלאות שלד (ימחק בסוף)
SET vSkeletonField = 'DataBase';

// רשימת טבלאות יעד (טבלאות סופיות שנטען אליהן עם Concatenate)
SET vTargetTables = 'Target_Items','Target_Invoices';


/***********************
2) יצירת טבלאות שלד (ריקות)
כדי שנוכל תמיד לעשות Concatenate בלי IF
************************/
FOR EACH vT IN $(vTargetTables)
    $(vT):
    NoConcatenate LOAD * Inline [$(vSkeletonField)];
NEXT vT;


/***********************
3) לולאה על כל ה-DBים
************************/
FOR EACH vDB IN $(vDBList)

    /**************************************************************
     טבלה A: שורות/פריטים (דוגמה: INVOICEITEMS + כותרת מ-INVOICES)
     Raw:    Raw_Items
     Target: Target_Items
    **************************************************************/
    Raw_Items:
    SQL SELECT
        // --- בחר רק שדות שאתה צריך ---
        ITM.IV,
        IVS.IVNUM
    FROM $(vDB).dbo.INVOICEITEMS ITM
    JOIN $(vDB).dbo.INVOICES     IVS
        ON ITM.IV = IVS.IV
    WHERE
        ITM.IVDATE >= $(vFromDatePriority)
    ;

    // שרשור הנתונים ליעד (תמיד, כי הטבלה קיימת כשלד)
    Concatenate(Target_Items)
    LOAD
        // --- דוגמה לפריפיקס כדי לייחד בין DBים ---
        '$(vDB)' & Text(IV) AS IV,

        // --- שדות כמו שהם ---
        IVNUM,

        // --- שדה עזר לזיהוי מקור ---
        '$(vDB)' AS SourceDB
    RESIDENT Raw_Items;

    DROP TABLE Raw_Items;


    /**************************************************************
     טבלה B: כותרות (דוגמה: INVOICES בלבד)
     Raw:    Raw_Invoices
     Target: Target_Invoices
    **************************************************************/
    Raw_Invoices:
    SQL SELECT
        IVS.IV,
        IVS.CUST
    FROM $(vDB).dbo.INVOICES IVS
    WHERE
        IVS.IVDATE >= $(vFromDatePriority)
    ;

    Concatenate(Target_Invoices)
    LOAD
        // --- פריפיקס לשדות מפתח ---
        '$(vDB)' & Text(IV)   AS IV,
        '$(vDB)' & Text(CUST) AS CUST,

        // --- מקור ---
        '$(vDB)' AS SourceDB
    RESIDENT Raw_Invoices;

    DROP TABLE Raw_Invoices;

NEXT vDB


/***********************
4) ניקוי: מחיקת שדה הדמה מטבלאות השלד
************************/
FOR EACH vT IN $(vTargetTables)
    DROP FIELD [$(vSkeletonField)] FROM $(vT);
NEXT vT;

// Exit Script;

///$tab שליפה ואחסון רשימה של טבלאות בלולאה
// משתנה שמכיל רשימת טבלאות (מופרדות בפסיקים)
LET vSfTables =

Campaign_Hierarchy_Level__c,

OpportunityLineItem,
Order,

OpportunityContactRole,
OpportunityTeamMember,
Meeting_Summaries_Line_Item__c,
User,
Agent__c,
Priority_Company__c,
Opportunity_Approval_Process__c,
Priority_Contract_Orders__c';


// לולאה ששולפת,מאחסנת וזורקת את הטבלה
FOR i = 1 TO SubStringCount('$(vSfTables)', ',') + 1

    LET vTableName = Trim(SubField('$(vSfTables)', ',', $(i)));
    TRACE Loading table: $(vTableName);

    IF Len('$(vTableName)') > 0 THEN

        [$(vTableName)]:
        SQL SELECT * FROM $(vTableName);

        STORE [$(vTableName)]
        INTO [lib://Data:DataFiles/salesforceDB/$(vTableName).qvd] (qvd);

        DROP TABLE [$(vTableName)];

    ENDIF

NEXT

///$tab Incremental Load - צריך לבדוק שעובד
//יש בעיה - מה קורה אם רשומה למחקת לגמרי ? אולי שווה אחת לחודש לעשות טעינה שוב של הדאטא
// * שלב 1 – חד פעמי (להריץ פעם אחת בלבד) *

// OpportunityHestory:
// SQL SELECT * FROM Opportunity;
// STORE [OpportunityHestory] INTO [lib://SandBox:DataFiles/SF-TEST/OpportunityHestory.qvd](qvd);

// // DROP TABLE OpportunityHestory;
// exit Script;

// 1) מקסימום LastModifiedDate מההיסטוריה
OpportunityHestoryMaxDate:
LOAD Max(Num(LastModifiedDate)) AS MaxLastModifiedNum
FROM [lib://SandBox:DataFiles/SF-TEST/OpportunityHestory.qvd](qvd);

LET vMaxDateNum = Peek('MaxLastModifiedNum', 0, 'OpportunityHestoryMaxDate');
DROP TABLE OpportunityHestoryMaxDate;

// SOQL datetime 
LET vDateForLoadingSOQL =
    Date($(vMaxDateNum), 'YYYY-MM-DD') & 'T' &
    Time($(vMaxDateNum), 'hh:mm:ss.fff') & '+0000';


// 2) שליפה אינקרמנטלית
OpportunityNew:
SQL SELECT *
FROM Opportunity
WHERE LastModifiedDate > $(vDateForLoadingSOQL);


// 3) טוענים Id-ים חדשים לזיכרון
NewIds:
LOAD DISTINCT Id RESIDENT OpportunityNew;


// 4) טוענים היסטוריה בלי ה-Ids האלו
NoConcatenate
OpportunityHestory:
LOAD *
FROM [lib://SandBox:DataFiles/SF-TEST/OpportunityHestory.qvd](qvd)
WHERE NOT Exists(Id);
DROP TABLE NewIds;

// 5) מוסיפים את הגרסאות המעודכנות
CONCATENATE (OpportunityHestory)
LOAD * RESIDENT OpportunityNew;

DROP TABLE OpportunityNew;


// 6) שמירה חזרה להיסטוריה (זה החלק שהיה חסר)
STORE OpportunityHestory INTO [lib://SandBox:DataFiles/SF-TEST/OpportunityHestory.qvd](qvd);

// DROP TABLE OpportunityHestory;

EXIT Script;
